arxiv-2302-14223.title: Bayesian Nagaoka-Hayashi Bound for Multiparameter Quantum-State Estimation Problem
arxiv-2302-14223.creator: Jun Suzuki
arxiv-2302-14223.description: Abstract In this work we propose a Bayesian version of the Nagaoka-Hayashi bound when estimating a parametric family of quantum states. This lower bound is a generalization of a recently proposed bound for point estimation to Bayesian estimation. We then show that the proposed lower bound can be efficiently computed as a semidefinite programming problem.
